references.text: Several people express a desire to follow Jesus but set conditions or hesitate. This reflects the situation in Matthew 8:19.
Jesus speaks about denying oneself and taking up one's cross to follow him, which resonates with the commitment expressed in Matthew 8:19.
Abraham's faith and willingness to follow God's call without knowing where he was going can be seen as a precursor to the kind of commitment Jesus expects, as in Matthew 8:19.
